history_scan.scope: All objects reachable from local refs; no remote fetch; regex triage, not a complete secret or privacy certification

collection_method.tracked_files: git ls-files -z; SHA-256 includes NUL delimiters and Git index order
collection_method.history_paths: git rev-list --objects --all; all locally reachable refs only, no fetch
collection_method.api_history_scan: git cat-file --batch; text regex triage for private-key headers, GitHub/Google/AWS tokens and quoted secret assignments; known sensitive paths excluded from matching; no matched values recorded
collection_method.limits: No remote environment, deployed release, credential validity, binary content, or exhaustive private-data certification. Historical .env.example content was excluded. Placeholder labels are heuristics, not clearance.

test_build.limits: Local build with existing installed dependencies and public assets; not a production publish artifact or a clean-install certification.
